notes.title: Public Testing
notes.content:
Hello All,
Today I'm extremely excited to announce that Prometheus will be hosting an open pre-alpha for PC. All aspects of this event will be held in our [url=https://discord.gg/JUJqNST]community discord[/url], where we will be aiming to test graphic capabilities and game mechanics as they are developed.

As development continues, I will be looking forward to community feedback, that will help mold and shape the game.

[i]When you join our [url=https://discord.gg/JUJqNST]discord server[/url], just ask for pre-alpha access[/i]
